source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: After this unit shoots on your turn, pick one enemy unit it hit. Through the rest of that [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), your army gets +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) when attacking the chosen unit.
